findings.summary: Z2's scan still skips its own file via 'if (f === thisFile) continue;'. The skip is currently harmless because the test holds the literal only in split form ("research:v1" + "-deep-research"), so the file text genuinely lacks the contiguous literal and the assertion now has real power over the dev-note that the previous attempt exempted. Removing the self-skip would close the residual hole where a future contiguous literal added to this file would go undetected.

Stale path reference in a comment: it cites 'profiles/deploy/production.env', a file that no longer exists after the rename. The channel literal on the adjacent assertion line was correctly updated to research:agent-harness.evidence, so no acceptance criterion is violated, but the comment now points at a deleted file.

Z4's profile scan is conditional ('if content includes 已核实存在 then require date + head_seq') and currently matches nothing, so it carries no power today. This matches the spec's own Z4 phrasing, whose verification method is manual reading rather than an assertion, and the substantive requirement is met: the profile comment states the concrete actor, timestamp, and GET result instead of a bare verification claim.
